x: Neil Hammersley and Jay Busk were also ever present all season. A mention should be made of our supporters who supplied liberal heaps of sandwiches throughout the season.

Highlights of the afternoon were the new club record set by Neil Hammersley, on home soil, in the 400h, breaking Mel Ford's old mark. The 4x400 also ended in excitement with Nigel from Blackheath and Jay fighting out the last leg.
Our 400 hurdlers produced a record number of points as Paul Beaumont set a new Club Record in his debut while previous record holder Neil Hammersley showed a return to form in the 'B' race.
